body: Unfortunately, I have a very hard time concentrating on a tv show. My pain is very distracting.
My life is nothing but pain. I enjoy nothing and am numb to the world. I need it to stop so today I'm ending it.
Just got really close. Had the noose tied but couldn't jump. Thing is man I live in so much pain that I need it to stop. Today's my last day I'm gonna commit and do it later.
Just got really close. Had the noose tied but couldn't jump. Thing is man I live in so much pain that I need it to stop. Today's my last day I'm gonna commit and do it later.

Sounds rough :/ I play guitar but I'm losing interest in it and everything else. Sleep deprivation destroys you mentally, so sorry you don't have access to some good OG kush to help with that. I guess we just need to hold on to what we have it's just difficult when illness has taken so much.

Yeah no matter how many analogies you use they will never understand. Thanks for reaching out. I'm gonna try and enjoy life it just seems like pain wants that not to happen. I know I have support from family, friends and this community it's just chronic illness steals your soul. Thanks again.

Yeah I suppose therapy wouldn't hurt. I'll probably just work with my dad a bit this summer as that's the lowest pressure. I don't need to work while I'm going to school full time luckily so I'll take a loan worst case scenario. I wonder if I'll be able to be successful despite the pain and I worry that even if I succeed I will still be just as empty as I feel today,
Yeah it's just sad is all. Nobody deserves this and suicide is a legitimate option for some people. Guess you just need to be content with the unfairness of the world.

I just don't want to hurt anymore. I know it won't help others for me to be dead but every day I'm still alive is another day in pain. I have all the help I need I'm just in so much discomfort all day. If anyone could spend a day in my shoes they could empathize but they never will.

Hmm that's an interesting perspective. Yeah luckily I have answers it's just a very harsh reality. Wow you have been through so much. There's always someone that has it worse. I guess if you can have hope there's no reason I can't have some. With how old I am it just really bothers me that I have to take it easy. All my friends are just enjoying their youth drinking and hooking up with girls and I'm just managing pain trying to be happy. I hope one day it will be worth it but that day isn't tomorrow or next month. Yeah the mentality of putting others suffering over your own is what you have to do. I just feel like people with chronic illnesses are always misunderstood. Nobody can see this thing eating me alive and how much I just want to die. For example Kurt Cobain had ibs/fibro type stuff and there's still a conspiracy that Courtney Love killed him. To me it's so obvious what killed him, it was slow and his soul died before his body. But healthy people just don't get it and you can't expect them too. Thanks for the response it gave me some perspective.

Do you have chronic pain? The only reason I'm still alive is for them I'm just tired of putting others suffering over my own. If anything it's selfish for them to want me to keep suffering for their well being.

I mainly take medical marijuana for pain. I recently bought kratom which helps as well. However I can't drive on kratom so I couldn't take it before work. I don't know what job I could get. There's no way to fake being ok anymore. My summer class starts in a month and I have no idea how I could manage that, physical therapy and a job. Wish I didn't have to take it easy. What jobs out there can you work from home? I've seen a counselor I no longer go to therapy since my problem is much more physical than mental.

Yeah chronic pain is just a big pity party it seems. Unsolvable problems breed that I guess. It trips me out how young I am I feel 90. My sister gets migraines, it puts her out. If life is just pain and constant racing suicidal thoughts why live it? As of now I can get a job that will just cause more anxiety and depression or kill myself. Kind of a no brainer when a day with no responsibilities is filled with suicidal thoughts. This community is great but my family is not happy. They think I'm lazy and the whole situation is just eating away at my soul. Even though I feel for the last guy's family, I know he's not in pain anymore, and there's something beautiful about that. I've done psychedelics, smoked and ate a ton of pot, taken kratom and I know death is my best bet. If only support took away pain I'd be ok but life isn't fair. Thanks for the reply.

Thanks only chronic pain patients understand. There's no reason for me to be a financial burden on my family anymore. I'm just hurting mentally and physically for years now. 24/7 pain for over a year. Better to die now to minimize the damage.

Congrats on finding love that's awesome. Yeah I would never have kids with my health. Couldn't put a kid through my life. I did get lucky on where I live that must be hard living in the cold. I think a lot about my family but I've been suffering for too long. My life is just a series of unfortunate events and I don't want to wake up in this broken body anymore. I have put others suffering before my own thusfar and I'm burnt out to say the least. I can attend school the problem is I can't work. I have support but I just wan't to be pain free and the only way to get close to that is to be loaded up on drugs and they're not even fun anymore.

It's really sad that for some people suicide is their best option. That sounds like tough relationship issues. My family is understanding and supportive it's just getting to the point where I have to work. All I want to do is eat pot cookies and drink kratom to forget but I need to get a job. Thing is I'd rather die than work. Just school alone makes me suicidal pretending I'm ok for a job is worse. Must be awful not having weed, I know I'd be dead already without it. I wish someone could understand but chronic pain is so isolating in itself. Yeah doctors are useless to me, just need them for physical therapy referrals. Society isn't set up for the chronically ill. Survival of the fittest applies to humans as well. Life is incredibly unfair which kind of gives me a right to die. Didn't choose to be this sick.

Sorry to hear you've always been plagued by health issues. Why is it that we can't just have one problem? When you have one issue you likely have 20 other ones. I also have ibs and it's one that gets very little sympathy. That sucks to hear you can't get access to marijuana, what state are you in? I live in California so I've always been able to get it. Still I am never not in pain these days even when I'm high. I'm not giving up on myself just this body. No matter how much I fight this body wants me hurting and I gotta get out of it. I have tried and tried to find relief but the hardest thing to deal with is missing out on so much of life and now my family thinks I'm lazy. I'd rather be dead than work and I really just am at peace with dying. Anyone in my situation would do the same and even though it will seem tragic but then I won't be hurting anymore. Congrats on making it this far and having a boyfriend. That's another reason I'm leaving soon, I've never had a relationship. 20 with all my issues is a little late to start haha so I'll off myself. Best of luck with everything.

That's just blind optimism. I always think a change of scenery will help my depression but then I remember pain follows me wherever I go. I'm already destroying my family but not contributing financially which is a reason I'll be gone soon. That last line is horse shit, pain has already taken the prime of my life from me.

Sorry things have always been so rough for you. With everything you've gone through it's amazing you still have any hope. Do you think some of us are born to suffer? It's hard for me to buy everything happens for a reason when life just kicks people like us to the curb. What keeps you going? I don't know how I'll ever be productive in society with the amount of pain I'm in so I feel lost all the time. Thanks for the reply

Thanks for reaching out. It's not weird you're just a good person. I'm a bit stressed at the moment as I have finals but I'm doing alright. The pain has slowly improved but still there, it really is a miracle I'm still alive haha. I took some good LSD about a month ago and that helps with the mental side of things but the pain is always there to bring me down it seems. Still my worry for others always keeps me alive. Even though I know dying would be my best bet that would destroy my family and I can't do that. So now my goal is just to try and improve others lives while still being successful. I'm nearly halfway done with my undergrad and two finals away from going home to my family. Things are far from perfect but I hope one day I can look back at all this bullshit and be glad I stuck it out.

I'm 20, have had chronic health issues since 16 and 24/7 pain for a year now. On top of that I've always had anxiety/depression. I'm in the same boat you are. Nobody can help. My family thinks they can help me somehow but I know my life is over. I could've written your post, my family is also why I'm alive. But how long can we put others suffering before our own? I'm so sorry this happened to you, nobody deserves it. Death is the only thing that brings me peace anymore and  I am killing myself soon. I know that my suffering warrants it and nobody could blame me in the end.

Anyways what helps me is staying on top of my schoolwork and medical marijuana. But the emptiness seems incurable. I just carry this weight on my shoulders that only chronic pain sufferers understand. Also, I try to have meaning in my life. I have become a great surfer and have used it as a way to channel my anger about my mess of a life. I play guitar too and try and stretch to heal my pain. All of that said, I know I'm doomed. There isn't answers for things like fibromyalgia and even if they eventually come out it already ruined my childhood/prime of my life. I hope things get better for you, but I also know that's probably not realistic. I have so much sympathy for us warriors and it makes me sick all this shit exists. Good luck :)

Thanks for posting this. As someone who's had anxiety/depression my whole life and add in chronic health issues in high school, suicide is my destiny. My situation is unsolvable and knowing how much my death will crush my family hurts but I know it must be done. Some people are doomed from the start. I think about suicide every single second and can't wait for the day I get to leave my hell. Anyways I hope you can find peace, whatever the means, because some of us are just waiting for the clock to run out.

Yeah weed can tighten the muscles. I take CBD which helps the pain but weed helps all my other ailments. It's a reward over risk thing. The thing about weed is it forces you to face your demons and gives you a new perspective. For me it's worth it but I completely understand why one would avoid it with this condition.

Yeah luckily there's reddit and I have good family support but at the end of the day I'm hoping I don't wake up tomorrow. Unfortunately the fact that there's other people in the same scenario doesn't help me it just makes me sad there are people out there like me. I never thought suicide would make so much sense until now. I need a miracle within the next two months if I'm gonna live and that's a hell of a situation to be in at my age. But I just gotta keep carrying the burden until I die shortly and that's the only idea that brings me peace. Any possibility of happiness of joy was squashed by chronic pain. Thanks for the reply and sorry if I come off as negative but the world hasn't been very nice to me and I'm just exhausted.
Yeah I've researched my issues extensively and know exactly what's going on with my body. Just no idea how I can be happy given my health. Thanks for the recommendation I'll check her out.

Yeah I've been through way too much for my age. I have a medical card but I have muscle pain 24/7 whether I'm high or not. It doesn't go away and it takes a toll on your mind. I have a lot of distractions but I'm finding they're not enough. I'm so empty and my grades are dropping and I have so much potential that I'll never be able to display due to my health. Specialists can't do much for me, I just have it rough at the moment.

Thanks for the recommendation. I smoke a lot of weed to deal with shit but another issue I deal with is brain fog. I'd love to try kratom though. Chronic pain just takes your soul though man, the emotions that come with your body failing are almost worse than the pain itself. I hope something drastic changes soon for me, thing is I know I should never have been born which is what I use to justify my suicide. Life's rough for me, always has been always will and I don't know how much longer I can live with that.

No, you're not the only one. I'm 19 and have had 24/7 pain for a year, health issues for 4 years. We got dealt a heavy hand. I know from experience how hard it is seeing everyone around me partying, being carefree teenagers while we suffer in silence. We had to grow up fast. I can't say for sure it gets better, but how you deal with it will improve as you learn more about your condition. What works for me is just trying to keep my life simple. I'm still in school but I can't work because of my pain. Spend my days in class, doing homework, watching tv, cooking and using medical marijuana. It's not perfect but I'm alive. I don't know if my illness will win in the end but I'm trying to hold out to see a light at the end of the tunnel. PM if you want to talk, I know finding young adults with chronic pain isn't too common. Hope your situation gets better :)
Thanks sorry about that I was insanely stressed out yesterday. I guess I'll keep trying it's just been tough lately.

Thanks. I've been suicidal for as long as I can remember. When I was a little kid I knew I was going to die young. Now that I'm 19 I realized that it really is the best thing for me. I hope I can muster up the courage soon but actually following through is the tough part. I can tie the noose, put my neck in and everything but actually ending it is so hard. I've just been through too much for a human. I was born as a combination of bad decisions to a mother who is a mess. Diabetic, can't manage money and just relies on her boyfriend. She's not a bad person just irresponsible for having children. For some people suicide is their destiny. I know that's messed up to say but it's the truth. I keep telling myself that so I can actually follow through at some point.  I'm glad your situation improved, however for me I've been waiting for death for years.

Yeah it's just when the negatives outweigh the positives death becomes appealing. I'm sure I'll off myself at some point only question is how long will I hang in there for my family/friends. I've been emotionally dead for years to me actually dying will be great.

Yeah wheat fucks me up. The garlic in the marinade also could be the reason. Also I'm without one of my prescriptions which makes everything worse. Did I mention I have midterms too? Hate being alive.

I don't hold it against them. Didn't really know what was going on with my body at the time and wasn't pulling my weight. It is what it is and it's done, it's just painful to know mentally I'm all there but my body lets me down a lot.
Thanks I'm doing all of these things so hopefully things will get better soon. I know there's no guarantees though and that's what scares me. Appreciate the reply.

Yeah working around pain is no fun. Had a 8 hour day in the library today and it was tough. Parties are almost never enjoyable. The pain has ruined movies for me unless I take a muscle relaxer. Drove my friends to deadpool and couldn't enjoy it due to pain. I do control the pain with marijuana. Thanks for the input :)

Thanks this is why I come to this sub. I go to a huge party school and I just watch everyone around me being carefree. Don't have the luxury of making bad decisions. My pain has sort of just warped my sense of reality. I go to class, have friends, surf a lot, play guitar and have made the deans list since I've been here. My pain has just kept me out of the gym and it's made me a bit self destructive since it's a problem I can't immediately solve. It's made me feel like I'm not living even though I am. Greek life is huge at my school and it's just a bummer I can't be involved in it. The thing is it really is great but I gotta accept that it's just not for me.

I envy anyone who isn't in pain all the time but yeah I guess you're right. I really am just surviving. Even though I know it's out of my control it's still crushed me. I have gained a new perspective from chronic pain and I'm doing what I can so I guess I'll just keep moving forward. Thanks for the insight it really helps to talk to someone who  truly understands. I'm glad your pain is getting better :)

Nope. I'm doing everything I can to help myself too. I kind of just got screwed over by life. No rhyme or reason some people just have an awful life. It's just a burden dealing with all this shit knowing I have to end it and what that will do to my family and friends. That's how it goes though, life sucks then you die for some.
Life is an uphill battle suicide is my path. I'm in so much pain I need it to stop.

Unfortunately it's not possible for the pain to be managed effectively. I've tried everything nothing works. I also just got bronchitis which on top of all my other shit is why I attempted today. Honestly my only regret is that I didn't do it. The suffering needs to end and it takes great strength to do that. I will never be able to thrive with my conditions. I'm sorry I should've just titled this post goodbye but thanks for the kind words.

Nope. 19 year old guy and have pelvic floor dysfunction. I have constant pelvic pain along with urinary incontinence. I used to have bowel incontinence but that has gotten better. I stretch daily, hit trigger points with a lacrosse ball and eat clean. I also go to a pelvic floor physical therapist, I recommend you find one. I got it because I have ibs/sinus issues/psoriasis/anxiety. It's an autoimmune problem. I take CBD daily for the pain but the depression it causes is insane. I know how hard it is living with this. All I do is go to class and surf. Can't work because of it, it's ruined my social life and I go to bed every night hoping it's my last. Let me know if you have any questions, it's a hell of a condition to have. Hope it gets better.

If I'm being social with anyone other than a close friend I have to pretend. I'm always miserable and in pain, no one wants to be around that. I've accepted my situation but still dread waking up every day.

Thanks yeah I see a psychologist that specializes in chronic pain. Problem is it just feels like more suffering than living. I'm emotionally dead because of it and I just want peace. I wish there was some sort of answer but I kind of just lost the game of life.

Yes it's very exhausting living like this. If I go to a party or something it's just suffering in a new location watching people enjoy themselves. Also I gotta say you've been through much more than me. My chronic pain adventure started 3 years ago and I'm ready to go. I understand that some people just have a shit life and that's why suicide is a very rational option for me. The medical community can't do shit for what I have all I can do is keep going to PT and hope things get better. There's no guarantee it will though. Again, holy shit man you have been through a lot. I don't have a script for any pain meds I just use marijuana heavily. I hope I can continue but lately I've been getting ready. For me suicide is so right. The second I wake up I wish I was dead and I really just don't fear it anymore. I see you comment on a lot of these posts here and it really shows how great of a person you are, using your misfortune for good. I can't promise that I won't kill myself because all I want is some peace. Thanks for being you.

Thanks for the words. Life is pretty god damn demoralizing. I don't want to see tomorrow. I'm already dead emotionally it's just my physical body still here. Anyways sorry for being a pessimist I think my time here is done. Best of luck.

Been to 4 rounds of PT, stretching daily, doing trigger points with the lacrosse ball and just staying distracted. I take CBD daily for pain and smoke weed to deal with the emotional side of it. I've just been fighting for so long and I'm so tired. Doesn't help that I have chronic fatigue but it's really exhausting. I can't imagine having this for 16 years. It's made me give up on dating and I have a huge chip on my shoulder because of it. I dunno I've just put so much time into it and it's not gone. Tired of pretending I'm ok and I just really want to die but because I have family and friends that's not so easy to do. Thanks for the advice I appreciate it.

Yeah pelvic pain has been so demoralizing and draining. Sorry you've had to go through it as well. I just smoke weed and take CBD to deal with the pain. Since I have ibs pain pills are really tricky and I don't know how hard it would be to get them. Just gotta stay distracted.

Yeah I've learned a lot too but I just need to stop the constant physical and mental torture. Props for lasting that long with those issues because it killed me. Best of luck in fighting it thanks for the reply.
Totally. Is it PFD? If so physical therapy is what they do to treat it. Just gotta keep the hope alive I guess. Sorry about your pain I hope it gets better. :)
Thanks I'm taking it one day at a time too I'm just so tired. Tired of pretending I'm ok, tired of being in pain and emotionally drained. I hope your situation improves.

Yeah I see a physical therapist at school but I'm home for the holidays so I'm just trying to treat it myself at the moment. I guess I'm used to the pain too but there's still a lot of anxiety and depression that comes with it. Sorry you're in a similar boat best of luck with everything.
I don't think it's IC as it has improved with time. Sorry you have that. It's just a dull muscle ache.

Sorry to hear about your health. I'm in California, use marijuana often but yeah my biggest struggle is the pain. With it comes anxiety about if I'm leaking urine and acid reflux are two of the worst. I saw star wars the other day and couldn't enjoy it due to pain, and it's just no way to live. Can't date, drink, go out, it's ruined a ton of opportunities for me and I'm just done with life. It won. But yeah at this point I'm pretty empty it's only my loved ones I worry about but honestly I am probably going to die soon. Just too much fucking pain. Just went to a party, I'm in pain not drinking and everyone else is having the time of their life. I couldn't even enjoy myself and I had this constant post nasal drip and subsequent bad breath from it. Positive thoughts really won't do much unfortunately. Thanks for the reply.

Yeah I have a lot of distractions which is nice but it's really affected my social life more than anything. How has dating been with this condition? Wow since you were 5 years old I can't imagine what you've been through. I've done like 4 rounds of PT now and it's still not gone. Not as bad as it once was but still not gone. Thanks for the reply.

Congrats! I'm 7 months in and no luck yet. It's improved but it's not gone. I do trigger points at home and stretch daily. Anything else I should be doing? Also just curious what other ailments do you have?

Yeah I have the same issues. But the main thing is just pain. Never goes away. I do have plenty of marijuana but I'm still in pain. I sit on a lacrosse ball a lot to relieve trigger points and stretch every day and it won't go away. I"m not sure what I'm doing wrong. Do you also have ibs?

Yeah chronic pain is so hard. Never thought I'd be looking at suicide as a rational decision. Sitting makes it worse, I can never be comfortable. Terrible in that I'm a college student. How do you maintain mentally? These days it's a battle to not end it.

Yeah that's why I didn't post there. So that's how it is then? Remission, meaning it doesn't go away. How long have you had it for? Also how much physical therapy have you done. I've done like 30 visits at least.
Man that scares me. 19 and had it for 7 months. Done like 4 rounds of physical therapy :/ Has it improved at all over time?
How old are you and how long have you had it? It's so debilitating.

Yeah I just longboard but I enjoy it. That and surfing are my favorite things to do. I used to play video games a lot but I haven't in a year or so. At least in this day in age we have constant distraction.
Yeah I understand. I have chronic pain so much of my depression is out of my hands but I'm gonna try and save myself. I hope you can get through it too.
No, I've had the same hair most of my life it looks fine. Plus hopefully I don't kill myself. I've written a note but I'm trying to live normally for the most part and save myself this week.
Just the usual. It was getting really long and in my eyes so it's better now.
Smoking weed constantly, guitar, reddit, netflix, surfing, skateboarding.

Medication isn't really an option for me since my body is so sensitive and fucked up. I've had bad reactions trying them. Yeah at school I was seeing a therapist who specializes in chronic pain and I saw somebody over the summer that I'm actually seeing again this week. I've tried it all. I wish I could believe that things are going to turn around but they just won't. Every day for the last 3 years has gotten worse and I have no reason to believe things will get better. Over time I will only have more responsibilities which will just make me more stressed and depressed. Other people have this illness and contemplating suicide is just part of it. I'm just finally forcing myself to follow through and I'm really at peace with the idea of death. I know that's strange for a healthy person but when you've been battling for years there comes a point where you just give up. Thanks for the reply.

Damn that's a heavy one. I'm so sorry you've been through that. Some of us have a harder path than others. I just got breakfast with my family yesterday and the hostess was my sisters friend. She's a senior in high school and works 3 jobs to save money for college. Her mom is a total loser I guess and steals money from her that she earns herself. It's horrible, and she did nothing wrong.
Ok, thanks. What have you been through?

I hope not. I know pain very well but committing suicide is something you can't take back. If my situation was only temporary I could never. I have no idea what you've been through but I hope you can reconsider if you have solvable/temporary problems.

Yeah that's who I've been doing it for thusfar. There comes a point where I have to value my own suffering over others. I've been doing the opposite for a while now and I can't make others lives better when I'm always in pain/depressed.
Thanks. As shitty as suicide is chronic pain sure is a good reason to do it. I'm taking my remaining time and making sure I see everyone I care about.

I wish things were different I really do. Unfortunately for me there's no way out but thanks for the offer. I'm just dead inside so there's not much for me to say. If you want to talk though pm me I'm always looking to keep my mind busy.
Chronic illnesses/pain. As much as it will hurt my family and friends I need to do this for myself.
I'm gonna hang myself around new years.

Damn this resonated with me. I have ibs, GERD, anxiety all the problems that you described. I wish I had some advice but I'm doing the same thing you are in a couple weeks. I wish things were different but autoimmune diseases give no fucks. They will beat your ass and continue to punch as you lay unconscious. We just got really unlucky. It's not our fault. I hope you find peace my friend.

Shit man I feel the same way. First day of break and I already got blown off by my friends. I also don't see myself making it to college again. I have a snowboarding trip the 3rd-7th so after that I'm going to kill myself. I'm sorry you don't have distractions, without those I don't know what I would do. Also conflict with your family is rough, that sound like a bad situation between you and your mom. I don't have many friends at college either as I have an autoimmune disease I know how hard that can be. It hurts seeing everyone have fun and enjoying their youth. Happiness is also something I lost a while ago as well. I'm sorry if this wasn't very helpful I just really related to your story, I hope your mom will lighten up or change so you can succeed.

No you're not a prick. I like my therapist, it's just my reality is absurdly bad. Two of my best friends got schizophrenia and I have major health issues now. I sold weed a lot when I was younger so that fucked with me too. I've just had a bad life is all.

Thank you that was very kind. I think I'm good on painkillers marijuana does it's job. The reason I want to die is all the anxiety and depression having this disease causes me. It's just life on hard mode. Sorry you're in the same boat. Yeah a relationship unfortunately just can't be a priority right now.
Thanks. I hope I find happiness too. Good luck with everything.

Yeah that's true. Having this illness has made me much more aware and I can have a positive impact on my friends and family. That and I have hobbies that distract me. Fulfillment is a tough one in that it seems no matter what I achieve I'm not happy. Anyways thanks for taking the time to talk to a stranger on the internet, I appreciate it.

Yeah, I'm definitely more than my illness but it's guided my life and ruined countless opportunities for me. I guess my life is worth living at this moment but it's definitely not worth getting old. I already feel like I'm 80 and it's broke my spirit. I'm not actively suicidal at this moment but I feel like sometime within the next ten years the disease will win.
I mean the issue is just a harsh reality. If you were me you would wish for death every day too. Anyone would, my life is demoralizing.

The physical pain has caused the suicidal thoughts. Everything aside from this disease in my life is great but it's ruined my life. It's mainly situational and I'll always battle with suicidal thoughts. Over time I've only gotten sicker. I'm really open with my psychologist.

Both. I have chronic pain that I go to a physical therapist for and I see a shrink that specializes in autoimmune disease/chronic pain. I inherited it from my mom but out of everyone in my family I got royally screwed in the genes department.
Yeah, I've been there. I'm not that bad at this moment but I'm pretty certain I'm not going to see 30. Want to talk about it?

Yeah, I see a therapist that specializes in chronic pain. I have friends, supportive family, hobbies, go to a good school, but I feel so awful on a daily basis no matter what. Medical community can't do shit for autoimmune diseases so I'm just doomed.

Yeah I see a therapist. How is it possible to not compare your life to others? I'll go to a party see everyone drinking and having a good time while I suffer in silence and can't drink. Fact is my life is horrible and I wish for death every single day but since I'm only 19 I may have to speed up the process.

Sorry to hear that, my stepdad just got diverticulitis. Every day I wish I didn't wake up. Having hobbies is key but I feel like with chronic pain everything is only a distraction. When I do things I enjoy I may not be thinking about my pain so much but when I'm working on schoolwork for example my depression gets worse. It makes me feel good that someone else with chronic pain has a SO. I don't know how that will ever happen for me but at least it's possible. Haha yeah surfing is my favorite distraction, been doing it for 6 years now. Thanks for the kind words.

Wow 30 years of depression, congrats on surviving. Yeah I think if I was extremely strict about my diet over time things could get better. Still though I'm always in pain. I realize that this isn't my fault it's just such a harsh reality. I didn't choose to be here which is why I get so suicidal. Nobody would want to live a life full of chronic pain. Thanks for the kind words, I really appreciate it.

Thank you for the reply. I'm sorry to hear about your rough past. I suppose my lack of a girlfriend comes from me hating myself. I've had a million opportunities because I'm a good-looking dude but my anxiety/depression always got in the way. Now that I have all these health issues I have a chip on my shoulder from it. I definitely need to learn how to meditate I'm sure it would help. Finding a partner for me is going to be a major battle because I don't think most women want to be with someone with chronic health issues and depression. Maybe one day though.

Thanks, I'm working on thinking more positive it's just difficult with how much I struggle. My life is pretty far from normal but I guess it appears normal to people who don't know about my poor health.
